items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: And I went to hear Elvin as many times as I could after that.

ctx.x: Hell of a place to start.

Yeah. And my poor teenage brain was blown apart. Because I had been playing rock & roll and blues. But I hadn’t started playing harmonica yet. So I heard this and I just wore the record out. I just listened over and over again, like what are these guys doing, what is it. I learned, basically I could sing a lot of what I had listened to. I listened so many times that I could sing Coltrane’s solos without understanding like what they were or anything like that. And then I discovered – New York had a great – I grew…
